name: RSS / Atom Digest
author: hearth-team
description: Fetch one or more RSS/Atom feeds and return the latest items (title, link, date, snippet) as clean markdown. No API key. Args: feeds (required — one URL, an array of URLs, or a comma/space/newline separated string; up to 20), limit (optional — max items per feed, default 5), hours (optional — only include items published within the last N hours). Great for a morning brief routine: the `text` field is ready-to-deliver markdown.
